message.content:
**Answer** The most visited market in New York City is the **Union Square Greenmarket**. | Market | Location | Typical Days Open | Why it’s the most visited | |--------|----------|-------------------|---------------------------| | Union Square Greenmarket | 14‑16 Union Square, Manhattan | Wednesday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday | • Largest farmers‑market in NYC (≈ 1 mile of stalls)
• Attracts ~ 30 000–40 000 visitors per week (estimates from NYC Parks)
• Offers a wide variety of produce, artisanal foods, and local products that draw both locals and tourists | **Quick facts** - **Size:** About 1 mile of vendor stalls, making it the biggest in the city. - **Foot‑traffic:** Roughly 30 000–40 000 people visit each week (estimates from NYC Parks and local news reports). - **Hours:** 8 a.m.–5 p.m. (varies slightly by day). - **Highlights:** Fresh produce, cheese, baked goods, flowers, and a rotating selection of local artisans. If you’re looking for a bustling, well‑visited market experience in NYC, Union Square Greenmarket is the go‑to spot.
